# body-only edits produce no deterministic structural delta

Edits that only change function bodies (for example changing a constant from 20 to 25) produce an empty deterministic delta — only structural changes are considered for the deterministic delta.

To treat body-level/behavioral changes as outside the deterministic structural delta (separating LLM/business-rule knowledge from structural compilation).

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_incremental.py` — `tests.test_incremental.test_pr_compile_produces_precise_delta`
